title: The Digital Privacy Database — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Real information from reliable public sources and official catalogs, fact-checked reference. Privacy settings, data-handling practices, and official guidance. The Digital Privacy Database documents privacy settings and data-handling practices: where to find the important settings on major platforms and devices, what each setting controls, and official guidance on data rights. Records are organized by platform so students can harden what they actually use. The Signature side adds privacy audits that walk through each platform's settings in order.
capabilities: Document privacy settings per platform with locations
Explain what each setting controls in plain language
Link to official data-rights guidance
Provide ordered privacy-audit walkthroughs
Track setting changes after platform updates
